tips.text: Buy extra relics for the part you need most; Systems is the slowest to land.
Bank Aya before the window opens; neither Aya nor relics expire when her stock rotates.
Refine the Rare Systems relics to Radiant and run them in a Radiant radshare; leave Common relics Intact.
Pick a teammate's identical reward on the reward screen; they get 5 bonus Void Traces.
